targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, payload FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.proxy_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '3 hours' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM latest;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, payload FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.proxy_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '3 hours' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM latest WHERE (payload->'scenario'->>'days_left')::float < 1;

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, payload FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.proxy_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '3 hours' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM latest WHERE (payload->'scenario'->>'days_left')::float < 3;

panels.title: Min дней до истечения
panels.description: Минимальное оставшееся время среди всех активных прокси — самый горячий.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, payload FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.proxy_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '3 hours' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT min((payload->'scenario'->>'days_left')::float)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM latest;

panels.title: Прокси: текущее состояние (отсортировано по сроку)
panels.description: Последний снимок по каждому прокси. Колонка 'Дней осталось' — это TTL. Сортируй кликом по колонке.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data) data, payload FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.proxy_snapshot' AND received_at > now() - interval '3 hours' ORDER BY data, received_at DESC) SELECT payload->'scenario'->>'provider' AS "Провайдер", data AS "IP:Port", payload->'scenario'->>'user' AS "Login", payload->'scenario'->>'pass' AS "Password", payload->'scenario'->>'proxy_type' AS "Тип", payload->'scenario'->>'country' AS "Country", (payload->'scenario'->>'expires_at')::timestamptz AS "Истекает", (payload->'scenario'->>'days_left')::float AS "Дней осталось" FROM latest ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->>'days_left')::float ASC;

panels.title: Days left — динамика
panels.description: Линия на каждый прокси. Спадает к нулю по мере приближения даты истечения; резко вверх — после продления.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS time, data AS metric, (payload->'scenario'->>'days_left')::float AS value FROM events WHERE service='infrastructure' AND type='system.proxy_snapshot' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at;
